description: The pie chart presents the distribution of items for the paper “Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse” across three year-based categories, shown as three slices. The slices are labeled 2016 (blue) at approximately 46.0% with a count of 46, 2018 (orange) at approximately 33.0% with a count of 33, and 2017 (green) at approximately 21.0% with a count of 21. Percentage and count labels are printed inside each slice, and the year labels appear outside near their respective segments. There is no visible legend, no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segments do not appear arranged in a clear ascending or descending order by size.
